rules.name: Get Stuck In
rules.effect: Melee weapons equipped by **^^Orks^^** models from your army have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Sustained Hits
rules.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

stratagems.name: Careen!
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an ORKS VEHICLE unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
stratagems.cond: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you roll a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as if they were not there.
stratagems.summary: Unit moves normally or falls back before Deadly Demise/Emergency Disembarkation; moves over non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemies.

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed models fight before removal if they haven't fought this phase.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.summary: Critical Hits on unmodified 5+ with melee attacks.

stratagems.name: ’ard as Nails
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS, MONSTER and VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Wound rolls on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Mob Rule
stratagems.timing: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One MOB unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Battle-shocked ORKS INFANTRY unit within 6" of that MOB unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
stratagems.summary: Remove Battle-shocked from friendly ORKS INFANTRY within 6".

stratagems.name: Ere We Go
stratagems.timing: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.
stratagems.summary: +2 to Advance and Charge rolls.

rules.name: Da Hunt Is On
rules.effect:
At the start of your Command phase, select one **MONSTER**, **VEHICLE** or **CHARACTER** unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Prey:
- When a friendly **BEAST SNAGGA** unit declares a charge, If your Prey is within 12" of that unit, you can use this part of this ability. If you do:
-- That **BEAST SNAGGA** unit can re‑roll that **charge roll**.
-- That **BEAST SNAGGA** unit <ins>must</ins> end that **charge move engaged** with your Prey
- Each time a **^^Beast Snagga^^** model from your army makes an attack that targets your Prey, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Drag It Down
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One BEAST SNAGGA unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Prey, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's melee weapons; Critical Hits on 5+ vs Prey.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Momentum
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a BEAST SNAGGA MOUNTED unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That BEAST SNAGGA unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If that enemy unit is your Prey, roll three additional D6.
stratagems.summary: Roll D6 for each model in unit (max 6): each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on enemy unit in Engagement Range. If Prey, roll 3 additional D6.

stratagems.name: Dat One’s Even Bigga!
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One BEAST SNAGGA unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls made for your unit. If you do, your unit must end that charge move engaged with your Prey.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to charge after Advancing or Falling Back; re-roll charge rolls (must engage Prey).

stratagems.name: Where D’ya Fink You’re Going?
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY or BEAST SNAGGA MOUNTED unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Unit not in Engagement Range moves up to 6".

stratagems.name: Stalkin’ Taktiks
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY or BEAST SNAGGA MOUNTED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack. In addition, if your unit has the INFANTRY keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.
stratagems.summary: Models gain Benefit of Cover vs ranged attacks; INFANTRY also gain Stealth until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One BEAST SNAGGA unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Remove unit from battlefield; place into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Try Dat Button!
rules.effect:
Each time a **^^Mek^^**, **^^Orks Walker^^** or **^^Grots Vehicle^^** unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, roll one D6. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the corresponding ability shown in the table below.
Alternatively, when such a unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can select one of the abilities above instead of rolling the D6. If you do, until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[HAZARDOUS]** ability as well.
If a weapon equipped by a model from your army has the **[HAZARDOUS]** ability from multiple sources, each time you take a Hazardous test for that weapon, it is failed on a roll of 1‑3.

rules.name: Keywords
rules.effect: **^^Gretchin^^** units from your army gain the **^^Battleline^^** keyword.

stratagems.name: Klankin’ Klaws
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS WALKER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit and, if you chose to push it, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons and they have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.
stratagems.summary: +2 S to melee weapons; if pushed: +1 D and [HAZARDOUS].

stratagems.name: Superfuelled Boiler
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS WALKER unit from your army has been selected to Advance.
stratagems.cond: That ORKS WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Advance rolls; grant [ASSAULT] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Bigger Shells for Bigger Gitz
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One MEK, ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll. If you chose to push it, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Wound rolls vs MONSTER/VEHICLE; push: +1 Damage and [HAZARDOUS] on ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If you chose to push it, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1; push option: re-roll any Hit roll but ranged weapons gain [HAZARDOUS].

stratagems.name: Conniving Runts
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One GRETCHIN unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move.
stratagems.summary: Roll D6; 4+ inflicts D3+1 mortal wounds on target enemy unit. Your unit makes a Normal move.

stratagems.name: Extra Gubbinz
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS WALKER or GROTS VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.summary: Subtract 1 from Damage of all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Conniving Runts
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One GRETCHIN unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move.
stratagems.summary: Roll D6; 4+ inflicts D3+1 mortal wounds on target enemy unit. Your unit makes a Normal move.

rules.name: Mob Mentality
rules.effect: Each time an attack targets a **BOYZ** unit from your army, models in that unit have a 6+ invulnerable save against that attack. Each time an attack targets a **BOYZ** unit from your army that contains 10 or more models, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save against that attack.

stratagems.name: Competitive Streak
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit contains 10 or more models, re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1; re-roll all Wound rolls if unit has 10+ models.

stratagems.name: Bulldozer Brutality
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in your unit are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
stratagems.summary: Models within 3" of enemies eligible to fight; can target enemies within 3" and Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: Braggin’ Rights
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: Two BOYZ units from your army that are within 6" of each other.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, while those two units are within 6" of each other, they both count as containing 10 or more models for the purposes of your Detachment rule, any Enhancements models from your army have and any Stratagems you use.
stratagems.summary: Both units count as 10+ models while within 6" until start of next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Come on Ladz!
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One BOYZ unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to your unit (excluding CHARACTER models).
stratagems.summary: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to unit (exclude CHARACTER).

stratagems.name: Tide of Muscle
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, add 1 to the Charge roll and, if your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.’
stratagems.summary: +1 to Charge rolls; re-roll Charge if unit has 10+ models.

stratagems.name: Go Get ’em!
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BOYZ unit this phase has shot.
stratagems.cond: That BOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Go Get ’em!
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BOYZ unit this phase has shot.
stratagems.cond: That BOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes surge move of up to D6".

rules.name: Da Boss Is Watchin'
rules.effect: At the start of your Command phase, in a turn in which you have not called a Waaagh!, if you have one or more **WARBOSS** models on the battlefield (or embarked within a **TRANSPORT** that is on the battlefield), you can call a Waaagh! for a second time this battle. When doing so, that second Waaagh! only counts as having been called for **WARBOSS**, **NOBZ** and **MEGANOBZ** units from your army.

stratagems.name: Armed to Dateef
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1; re-roll any Hit roll if Waaagh! active.

stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if a Waaagh! is active for your unit. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Model destroyed before shooting/fighting: roll D6 (+2 if Waaagh! active); 5+ stays in play to shoot/fight, then removed.

stratagems.name: Always Lookin’ Fer a Fight
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed.
stratagems.cond: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that destroyed that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3". If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, it can move up to 6" instead.
stratagems.summary: Consolidation moves up to D3+3" (or 6" if Waaagh! active).

stratagems.name: Krushin' Impact
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+ instead.
stratagems.summary: Roll D6 per model in Engagement Range: 5+ = 1 mortal wound (max 6). If Waaagh! active: 4+ instead.

stratagems.name: Cut’em Down
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.cond: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if a Waaagh! is active for your unit, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
stratagems.summary: Enemy unit takes Desperate Escape test when Falls Back; -1 to test if Waaagh! active.

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on incoming attacks.

rules.name: Adrenaline Junkies
rules.effect: **SPEED FREEKS** units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit is a VEHICLE unit with an unmodified Toughness characteristic of 8 or less, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save instead.
stratagems.summary: 5+ invulnerable save; 4+ if VEHICLE with Toughness 8 or less.

stratagems.name: Squig Flingin’
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: That SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.
stratagems.summary: Target enemy unit within 9" takes Battle-shock test at -1.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. While targeting a unit within 9", they have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's ranged weapons; [SUSTAINED HITS 2] within 9".

stratagems.name: Blitza Fire
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 9", a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LETHAL HITS] to ranged weapons; Critical Hits on 5+ for targets within 9".

stratagems.name: Full Throttle!
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Wound rolls in melee for the turn.

stratagems.name: More Gitz Over ’ere!
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One SPEED FREEKS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes Normal move up to 6".

rules.name: Lissen 'Ere
rules.effect:
Friendly **STORMBOYZ** units have **BATTLELINE**.
- When a friendly **BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ** unit is selected to make an **advance/fall‑back move**, that move does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to start an action**.

stratagems.name: Taktikal Retreat
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KOMMANDOS/ STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.cond: That KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge
stratagems.summary: Fall Back and still charge this turn.

stratagems.name: On to Da Next
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes normal move up to 6".

stratagems.name: Ded Sneaky
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves
stratagems.summary: Place unit in strategic reserves.

rules.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
rules.effect:
Friendly **ORKS INFANTRY** units’ ranged attacks have **[ASSAULT]**.
- In your Shooting phase, if the Waaagh! is active for your army, friendly **ORKS INFANTRY** units’ ranged attacks have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.

stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.cond: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
stratagems.summary: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Speshul Shells
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.cond: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.
stratagems.summary: +1 AP on ranged attacks vs targets within 9".

stratagems.name: Call Dat Dakka?
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.summary: Unit shoots using snap shooting; can only target that enemy unit.

rules.name: Here Be Loot
rules.effect:
At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker. Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is your loot objective.

Each time a model in an **^^Orks Infantry^^**, **^^Orks Mounted^^** or **^^Orks Walker^^** unit from your army makes an attack, that attack has the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability if either or both of the following are true:

- That model's unit is within range of your loot objective.
- That attack targets a unit within range of your loot objective.

rules.name: Sustained Hits
rules.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

stratagems.name: Bash and Grab
stratagems.timing: The Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of the loot objective, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Wound rolls against enemies within range of loot objective.

stratagems.name: Grab and Bash
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding GRETCHIN units) that is within range of the loot objective.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle. Designer’s Note: This means that any abilities that are in effect while the Waaagh! is active for your army will be in effect for your unit.

This ability always takes the form **[MELTA X]**. Each time a model makes an attack with a **[MELTA]** weapon, if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step, until the attacking unit’s attacks have been resolved, add **X** to that weapon’s **D** characteristic. 
***Example:** A model targets a unit that is within half range of a **[MELTA 2]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of D6. While resolving those attacks, that weapon has a **D** characteristic of **D6+2**.*

glossary.name: Lethal Hits
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[LETHAL HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
***Designer’s Note:** Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no **wound roll** is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a **critical wound** and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

glossary.name: Scouts
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: 
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone. 
- If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a **scout move**. 
- If that unit is embarked within a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** has the Scouts ability, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** can make a **scout move**.

glossary.name: Indirect Fire
glossary.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapon can shoot using indirect shooting (10.07).

glossary.name: Feel No Pain 5+
glossary.effect: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

glossary.name: Support
glossary.effect:
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each **leader** and **support** unit in your army, you can select one friendly **bodyguard** unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that **bodyguard** unit for the battle and form an **attached** unit with it. 
Unless otherwise stated, each **bodyguard** unit can only have one **leader** unit and one **support** unit attached to it.

glossary.name: Cleave
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[CLEAVE X]**. Each time you gather **attack dice** for a **[CLEAVE]** weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add **X** additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). 
***Example: If a **[CLEAVE 1]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Psychic
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[PSYCHIC]** weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s **BS** or **WS** characteristic and any or all modifiers to the **hit roll**. Attacks made with **[PSYCHIC]** weapons are known as **psychic attacks** (this can be important for the triggering of other rules).

glossary.name: One Shot
glossary.effect:
Each weapon with this ability can only be selected to make attacks with once per battle. 
If a **destroyed** model is returned to a unit, all of its **[ONE SHOT]** weapons that have already been selected to make attacks with during the battle cannot be selected to make attacks with again. 
If a new unit is added to an army, all **[ONE SHOT]** weapons in that unit can be selected to make attacks with once per battle.

glossary.name: Crucible
glossary.effect: A **^^Character^^** created using Crucible rules has the Crucible ability. Your army may include up to three units with the Crucible ability and these units cannot be given Enhancements.
